contractReview.coverage: Source-observed adapter literals plus selected shared execution helper contracts; not exhaustive runtime HTTP characterization.
limitations: Status codes forwarded dynamically from services/auth/helpers require per-feature network characterization before extraction.
Header entries are conditional observations, not assertions that every response has every listed value.
Original baselineRevision and generatedAt describe the original source inventory, not the correction commit.
